The purpose of this work is to study Ly$\alpha$, He II, and C IV  nebulae around radio-loud quasars at z$=$2 with spatially resolved radio jet emission and compare the CGM emission to the radio jet emission.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA 2017.1.01527.S.

We present Ly$\alpha$, He II, and C IV  observations of 7 redshift $\sim$ 2 radio-loud quasars observed using the Keck Cosmic Web Imager (KCWI) and compare it to observed radio jet emission using archival VLA and ALMA radio observations.
We have carried out an optical IFS survey of 7 radio-loud quasars with radio jet emissions at z$=$2 using Keck KCWI

We present Ly$\alpha$, He II, and C IV  observations of 7 redshift $\sim$ 2 radio-loud quasars observed using the Keck Cosmic Web Imager (KCWI) and compare it to observed radio jet emission using archival VLA and ALMA radio observations.
